scope: A locked Go OS thread pinned with the process to the lowest permitted logical processor brackets each fresh scanner preparation, load, analysis, verified-MIR lowering and C emission with QueryThreadCycleTime. Eight builds per lane per pair reduce per-build variation; GC runs outside each interval and automatic GC is disabled. Thread cycles are not elapsed time and omit work on other threads, off-CPU waits, native MSVC children and ordinary GC. Source/C hashes and counts remain checked. An identical-source null must pass before the candidate screen; neither result alone establishes normal check/build latency or the C-relative runtime gate.
